xccdf:Profile.xccdf:title: STIG with PE-9043 availability values
xccdf:Profile.xccdf:description: Refines auditd disk-space actions to SYSLOG (a STIG-accepted value) so a full COS_PERSISTENT cannot halt the node. admin_space_left_action remains single (required by auditd_data_retention_admin_space_left_action).
